criteria.description: A routing plan selects one registered Kernel task workflow independently from Domain capabilities.
The Task Envelope separates concrete task facts from reusable routing concepts.
The Routing Plan records structured risk assessment and approval gates.
Validation rejects missing workflow provenance, contradictory approval state, and problem-specific Skill identifiers.
Documentation defines the lifecycle and professional capability boundaries.
Android examples keep concrete task facts in the envelope, fail closed without an active registered capability, and illustrate only a future generic Skill binding.
